title: AI integration

seo.title: AI integration services for websites
seo.description: AI assistants, search and workflow automation wired into your own data, with transcripts saved against every lead and human handover. From $12,000.

answerBlock: AI integration is connecting language models to your website, data and workflows so they do useful work, such as qualifying enquiries, answering from your knowledge base or automating repetitive tasks. Calwebtech builds assistants and automations on the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, saves every transcript against the lead in your own database, and hands over to a person when it matters. Projects typically cost $12,000 to $60,000, depending on scope and integrations.

hero.outcome: An assistant that qualifies enquiries at any hour, answers from your own knowledge base and passes a warm lead to a person when it matters.

problem.heading: When is AI integration worth it for a business?
problem.intro: The useful AI projects we see start from a specific, repetitive job, not from a wish to add AI.

situations.title: Enquiries arrive when nobody is there
situations.body: Buyers visit in the evening, ask a question the site does not answer and leave before anyone can reply the next morning.

situations.title: Your team answers the same questions all day
situations.body: Specification, availability, process and pricing questions have answers in documents your team already wrote, but finding them takes a person.

situations.title: Staff retype information between systems
situations.body: Emails, forms and documents are read and copied into the CRM or ERP by hand, which is slow and where mistakes creep in.

included.heading: What does an AI integration project include?
items: A workshop to pick one job worth automating and define what good looks like
An assistant trained on your knowledge base, with answers grounded in your own documents
Qualification questions that capture budget, timeline and needs as structured fields
Transcripts saved against the lead in your own database
Human handover when it matters, by email, chat or a booked call
Search across your content and documents using vector search
Workflow automation between email, forms, your CRM and your ERP
Guardrails: what the assistant must not answer, and how it says so
An evaluation set of real questions, run again before every change
Usage and cost monitoring, with model providers billed to your own account

process.heading: How does an AI integration project run?
process.intro: A narrow first release in six to eight weeks, measured against real questions before it grows.

steps.title: Pick the job
steps.body: One workflow chosen, the data it needs identified, and success written down as questions the assistant must answer correctly.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.body: A working prototype on your own content, tested against the evaluation set with your team.

steps.title: Build and integrate
steps.body: The assistant or automation built into your site and systems, with transcripts, handover and guardrails in place.

steps.title: Prove
steps.body: Evaluation against real questions, security and data checks, and a soft launch to a small group of visitors or staff.

steps.title: Launch and measure
steps.body: Full launch, monitoring of answers, costs and handovers, and a review of what to automate next.

technology.heading: Which AI technologies do you use?

pricing.heading: How much does AI integration cost?
pricing.intro: Most first releases land between $12,000 and $25,000. Several connected systems, large document sets or custom workflows move a project into the $25,000 to $60,000 band. Model usage is billed to your own account.

factors.title: How complex the job is
factors.body: Answering questions from a tidy knowledge base is simpler than a workflow that reads, decides and writes into several systems.

factors.title: Data preparation
factors.body: Clean, current documents are quick to use. Scattered, outdated or conflicting material needs sorting before an assistant can rely on it.

factors.title: Integrations
factors.body: Each connected system, such as a CRM, ERP or calendar, adds build and testing time.

factors.title: Guardrails and review
factors.body: Regulated topics or high-stakes answers need stricter rules, more evaluation and human review.

factors.title: Model usage
factors.body: Running costs depend on volume and model choice, and are billed to your account, so they are visible from day one.

faq.heading: What do buyers ask about AI integration?

items.question: Will an AI assistant give our customers wrong answers?
items.answer: It can if it is left to improvise, so we ground answers in your own documents, write down what it must not answer, and test it against a set of real questions before every change. When it is unsure, it hands over to a person.

items.question: Where does our data go?
items.answer: Documents, transcripts and leads are stored in your own database. Requests to model providers go through accounts in your name, and we set out what each provider retains before you choose one.

items.question: Which AI models do you use?
items.answer: We build on the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and choose per job, based on answer quality, speed and cost in testing. The code keeps the provider swappable, so you are not tied to one.

items.question: Can the assistant book calls or create leads?
items.answer: Yes. It can capture qualification answers as structured fields, save the transcript against the lead, and book a call or alert your team when a person should take over.

items.question: How long does an AI integration take?
items.answer: Six to eight weeks for a focused first release. We start narrow, measure it against real questions and expand from there.

items.question: What does an AI assistant cost to run each month?
items.answer: Model usage depends on volume and the model chosen, and is billed to your own account. We estimate it during the prototype and set up monitoring, so costs are visible from launch.

items.question: Do we need a new website to add AI features?
items.answer: No. Assistants and automations connect to your existing site and systems. If the site cannot store leads properly, we say so and scope that separately.
